notablePrerequisites: Kaya has at least three loyalty counters on it.
description:
Activate Kaya's third loyalty ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, exiling Three Blind Mice and creating a token copy of it that is a 1/1 Soldiers in addition to its other types.
The Three Blind Mice token enters the battlefield with two lore counters on it due to Vorinclex, triggering its first and second chapter abilities.
Resolve the first Three Blind Mice trigger, creating a 1/1 Mouse creature token.
Resolve the next Three Blind Mice trigger, creating a token copy of the Three Blind Mice token.
Repeat from step 2.
